text:
emily: Quick postmortem follow-up: we still have three open action items from the outage thread. Need owners, Jira links, and a short timeline so we can close the PM. Items: (A) short-term cache eviction fix, (B) regression/eval coverage, (C) incident-pattern consolidation + RCA notes.
tarun: I can own (A) the code fix and will open a ticket. ETA for a PR draft: 4 business days.
leah: I'll take (B) regression checks and add a nightly CI job that flags memory/regression. Will add acceptance thresholds.
oscar: I'll consolidate past incidents and produce a short recurrence summary + attach grep outputs to the ticket.
pm-bot: Jira RW-5201 created by @tarun - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-5201
tarun: RW-5201: reduce kv retention window + eviction backpressure. Assignee=tarun. Acceptance criteria: under synthetic workload 'prefix-burst', kv_cache_size 95th percentile <= baseline +10% for 24h. PR draft by 2026-04-06.
leah: For regressions: AC for CI job: nightly check fails if 95th pct memory increases >7% vs baseline for 3 consecutive runs. I'll attach the eval prompt we used.
oscar: Grep/analysis snippets I'll attach to RW-5201 Diagnostics: 
```
zgrep "kv_cache_size" /var/log/*/service.log | sort -k3 -n | tail -n 60
awk '/eviction/ || /oom/ {print $0}' /var/log/incidents.log | sed -n '1,200p'
```
emily: Please include a tiny RACI table in RW-5201 and link the PM postmortem doc. Proposed: Tarun=R, Leah=A, Oscar=C, Emily=I.
tarun: Handing rollout checklist and canary steps to @leah; I remain primary for the bugfix PR.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled for rw-dedicated-prod by @leah on 2026-04-09T05:00Z
leah: I'll publish the canary playbook in the ticket and set monitoring alerts for kv growth and eviction spikes.
oscar: I'll attach sample outputs from two previous incidents and a one-paragraph summary stating they match on "eviction burst + long prefix usage" signature.
emily: Proposed timeline: PR draft by 2026-04-06, review 2026-04-07, staged canary 2026-04-09, close PM follow-up by 2026-04-16 if canary stable. Sound good?
tarun: ack :thumbsup:
leah: ack
oscar: ack
pm-bot: Reminder created: PM follow-up RW-5201 sync - 2026-04-07 09:00 UTC
emily: Let's keep updates in RW-5201 and only post major status here. If anyone needs more time call it out ASAP.
